title: 5 Quiet Luxury Gifts Worth Spending Properly On
description: One serious gift beats five small ones: a Swiss automatic watch, a pure cashmere throw, a navy cashmere V-neck, a Givenchy eau de parfum and a pair of Waterford Lismore crystal glasses.
intro: Five small gifts are forgotten by February. One gift chosen properly is still in use ten years later — and the person still remembers who gave it.
Each piece below is the permanent version of something the person already uses every day. That upgrade, from the ordinary version to the lasting one, is where the gift lands.

picks.name: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80, Ice Blue
picks.kicker: The watch to give when you only give one
picks.alt: Tissot PRX Powermatic 80, 40 mm, ice blue waffle dial on an integrated steel bracelet
paras: The PRX shape comes from a Tissot case first made in 1978: a flat, integrated steel bracelet and a waffle-textured dial. The Powermatic 80 movement inside keeps running for about 80 hours off the wrist — take it off on Friday and it is still ticking on Monday.

The detail he will enjoy explaining: P and R stand for Precise and Robust, and the X is the Roman numeral ten — for 10 bar, or 100 metres, of water resistance. It is Swiss made, and it is the one piece on this list that can be handed down.
picks.verdict: a graduation, a promotion, or a fortieth birthday.

picks.name: State Cashmere Fringe Throw, Camel
picks.kicker: The gift the whole house will use
picks.alt: State Cashmere 100% cashmere throw with fringe, camel, 60 by 50 inches, folded
paras: A cashmere throw is opened once and then used every evening by whoever sits down first. This one is 100% pure cashmere, 60 by 50 inches — large enough to cover a person, not just a lap.

Why it feels special: the fibre is Grade A cashmere from Inner Mongolia, where goats grow their softest undercoat to survive winters far below freezing. Warmth without weight is the whole point of it.
picks.verdict: a new home, a couple, or anyone whose sofa still has a fleece blanket on it.

picks.name: State Cashmere Men's V-Neck, Navy
picks.kicker: The sweater he reaches for first
picks.alt: State Cashmere men's V-neck sweater in navy, 100% cashmere
paras: Navy goes with every shirt a man already owns, and a V-neck sits equally well over a collar or a T-shirt. It is the one piece of clothing you can give without knowing his exact taste.
The quiet luxury detail: it is knitted from 100% cashmere in a 2-ply, 26-gauge knit, and the brand notes that pure cashmere grows softer the longer it is worn. Order the size he actually wears.
picks.verdict: the man whose sweaters are all cotton and who has never owned cashmere.

picks.name: Givenchy Gentleman Boisée Eau de Parfum
picks.kicker: The evening fragrance, in its best bottle
picks.alt: Givenchy Gentleman Boisée eau de parfum, 3.4 oz bottle
paras: Gentleman Boisée opens with black pepper, settles into iris and cocoa, and finishes on sandalwood and patchouli. Warm and woody rather than sweet, it is made for dinners rather than the office.
What makes it a proper gift: Givenchy makes it in France in its own ateliers, and the 3.4 oz bottle lasts long enough to become his signature scent.
picks.verdict: the man who owns one fresh daytime scent and nothing for the evening.

picks.name: Waterford Lismore Double Old Fashioned, Set of 2
picks.kicker: The glasses that outlive the giver
picks.alt: Pair of Waterford Lismore cut crystal double old fashioned glasses
paras: The first thing anyone notices when picking up a Lismore glass is its weight. The diamond and wedge cuts catch light from every side — a drink poured into it feels like an occasion, even on a Tuesday.
The story worth telling at the table: Waterford's designer Miroslav Havel created the Lismore pattern in 1952 as a tribute to the 800-year-old Lismore Castle in Ireland, and it has not changed since.
picks.verdict: the person who has everything, and whose glasses came from the supermarket anyway.

closing: One box, not five. If the budget reaches the watch, give the watch alone. A single serious gift is remembered; extras only dilute it.
